tasks.title: Implement Resource Unit Test Framework and Templates
tasks.description: Create comprehensive unit testing framework with templates for all Terraform resource CRUD operations, schema validation, and error handling
tasks.details: Implement test templates for resource CRUD operations including Create, Read, Update, Delete, and Import functionality. Create schema validation tests for all required/optional fields, input validation tests, error handling tests, state management tests, and resource dependency tests. Framework must support testing computed fields, default values, and edge cases. Use Go testing package with Terraform Plugin SDK v2, testify/assert for assertions, and follow established patterns. Include helper functions for random resource name generation, test environment setup, and cleanup automation.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate framework with smoke tests on 5 sample resources, verify all CRUD operations work correctly, ensure schema validation catches invalid inputs, test error scenarios return appropriate messages, and confirm template generates passing tests for existing resources

tasks.title: Implement Priority 1 Core Infrastructure Resource Tests
tasks.description: Create comprehensive unit and integration tests for 40 Priority 1 core infrastructure resources including accounts, gateways, and network resources
tasks.details: Implement 100% test coverage for P1 resources: Account Management (aviatrix_account, aviatrix_account_user, aviatrix_access_account), Gateway Resources (aviatrix_gateway, aviatrix_transit_gateway, aviatrix_spoke_gateway, aviatrix_edge_spoke, aviatrix_edge_csp, aviatrix_edge_zededa, aviatrix_edge_vm_selfmanaged), Network Resources (aviatrix_vpc, aviatrix_transit_vpc, aviatrix_spoke_vpc, aviatrix_aws_tgw, aviatrix_azure_vnet, aviatrix_gcp_network), and Connectivity (aviatrix_transit_gateway_peering, aviatrix_spoke_transit_attachment, aviatrix_aws_tgw_vpc_attachment, aviatrix_site2cloud, aviatrix_tunnel). Each resource must have comprehensive CRUD tests, import tests, schema validation, and error handling.
tasks.testStrategy: Execute unit tests achieving >=95% statement coverage for each resource, run integration tests on all 4 cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI), validate resource lifecycle (create → read → update → delete), test import functionality with valid/invalid IDs, and ensure cleanup automation prevents resource leaks

tasks.title: Implement Multi-Cloud Integration Test Framework
tasks.description: Build integration testing framework supporting AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI with resource lifecycle testing, cross-resource dependencies, and automated cleanup
tasks.details: Create integration test framework that validates real cloud provider API interactions across all 4 supported clouds. Implement resource lifecycle testing (create → read → update → delete), cross-resource dependency testing, state consistency validation, and test isolation mechanisms. Framework must support parallel test execution, automated cleanup, and proper error handling. Use Docker Compose for orchestration, separate networks per cloud provider, and environment-specific configurations. Include pre-check functions for each cloud provider and comprehensive credential validation.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate framework works on all 4 cloud providers, execute parallel tests without conflicts, verify automated cleanup removes all created resources, test isolation prevents cross-test interference, and ensure execution time <60 minutes for full suite

tasks.title: Implement Data Source Testing Framework and Coverage
tasks.description: Create comprehensive testing framework for all 23 data sources with read operations, query parameters, filtering, and error handling
tasks.details: Implement test templates and comprehensive coverage for all 23 data sources including Account & Identity (aviatrix_account, aviatrix_caller_identity), Gateway Data Sources (aviatrix_gateway, aviatrix_transit_gateway, aviatrix_spoke_gateway, aviatrix_transit_gateways, aviatrix_spoke_gateways), Network Data Sources (aviatrix_vpc, aviatrix_vpc_tracker, aviatrix_network_domains), Firewall Data Sources (aviatrix_firenet, aviatrix_firewall, aviatrix_firewall_instance_images, aviatrix_firenet_vendor_integration), and Smart Groups & DCF (aviatrix_smart_groups, aviatrix_dcf_webgroups, aviatrix_dcf_mwp_attachment_points). Test read operations, filter/query parameters, non-existent resource handling, multiple result handling, and schema validation.
tasks.testStrategy: Achieve >=90% test coverage for all data source files, validate query parameters work correctly, test error cases for non-existent resources, verify multiple result handling, and ensure schema validation catches invalid configurations

tasks.title: Implement Priority 2 Advanced Feature Resource Tests
tasks.description: Create comprehensive tests for 50 Priority 2 advanced feature resources including FireNet, Distributed Firewalling, Security, and VPN components
tasks.details: Implement 90% test coverage for P2 resources: FireNet (aviatrix_firenet, aviatrix_firewall_instance, aviatrix_firewall_instance_association, aviatrix_firewall_management_access, aviatrix_centralized_transit_firenet), Distributed Firewalling (aviatrix_distributed_firewalling_config, aviatrix_distributed_firewalling_policy_list, aviatrix_distributed_firewalling_intra_vpc), Security (aviatrix_fqdn, aviatrix_fqdn_tag_rule, aviatrix_firewall_policy, aviatrix_segmentation_security_domain), and VPN (aviatrix_geo_vpn, aviatrix_remote_syslog, aviatrix_vpn_user, aviatrix_vpn_profile). Focus on complex configuration scenarios and advanced feature interactions.
tasks.testStrategy: Execute comprehensive test suites achieving >=90% coverage, validate complex configuration scenarios, test advanced feature interactions, ensure proper error handling for invalid configurations, and verify integration with core infrastructure resources

tasks.title: Implement Priority 3 Supporting Feature Resource Tests
tasks.description: Create tests for 43 Priority 3 supporting feature resources including Controller Configuration, Advanced Networking, and Monitoring components
tasks.details: Implement 80% test coverage for P3 resources: Controller Configuration (aviatrix_controller_config, aviatrix_controller_email_config, aviatrix_controller_cert_domain_config, aviatrix_controller_bgp_max_as_limit_config), Advanced Networking (aviatrix_aws_tgw_connect, aviatrix_aws_tgw_connect_peer, aviatrix_aws_tgw_directconnect, aviatrix_azure_vng_conn, aviatrix_azure_spoke_native_peering), and Monitoring & Operations (aviatrix_cloudwatch_agent, aviatrix_datadog_agent, aviatrix_copilot_association, aviatrix_splunk_logging). Focus on configuration management and operational features.
tasks.testStrategy: Achieve >=80% test coverage for supporting resources, validate configuration management scenarios, test operational feature functionality, ensure proper integration with monitoring systems, and verify administrative configuration changes

tasks.title: Implement Advanced Acceptance Test Scenarios
tasks.description: Create complex multi-resource workflow tests, state migration tests, version upgrade tests, and configuration drift detection
tasks.details: Implement advanced acceptance testing capabilities including complex scenario testing with multi-resource workflows, state migration testing between provider versions, version upgrade path validation, configuration drift detection, Terraform plan validation, and apply/destroy idempotency testing. Create test scenarios that mirror real-world usage patterns and validate provider behavior across version upgrades. Include comprehensive state consistency checks and drift remediation testing.
tasks.testStrategy: Execute complex multi-resource scenarios successfully, validate state migration across provider versions, verify upgrade paths maintain compatibility, test drift detection accurately identifies changes, and confirm idempotency for apply/destroy operations

tasks.title: Implement Performance and Security Testing Suite
tasks.description: Create benchmark tests, performance baselines, load testing, and comprehensive security validation for the provider
tasks.details: Implement performance testing with benchmark tests for critical operations, resource creation performance baselines, API rate limiting tests, concurrent resource creation tests, and large-scale deployment testing. Create security testing suite with credential handling validation, sensitive data masking tests, TLS/SSL validation, API authentication testing, authorization boundary testing, and security regression tests. Include performance regression detection and security scan integration with Gosec and GitHub Code Scanning.
tasks.testStrategy: Establish performance baselines for critical operations, validate rate limiting handles concurrent requests properly, test large-scale deployments successfully, ensure credential handling is secure, verify sensitive data masking works correctly, and confirm security scans detect vulnerabilities

tasks.title: Implement Test Coverage Monitoring and Quality Gates
tasks.description: Create comprehensive test coverage monitoring, quality gates for CI/CD pipeline, and flaky test detection systems
tasks.details: Implement test coverage monitoring with daily coverage reports, per-PR coverage diff analysis, coverage badges for README, historical coverage trends, and uncovered code analysis. Create quality gates including merge requirements (all tests pass, coverage doesn't decrease, no critical security issues), release requirements (100% P0 resource coverage, >=90% overall coverage), and flaky test detection with quarantine system. Integrate with GitHub Actions for automated enforcement and reporting.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate coverage reports generate correctly, verify quality gates block merges when requirements not met, test flaky test detection identifies intermittent failures, ensure coverage trends track properly over time, and confirm badge generation reflects current coverage

tasks.title: Create Comprehensive Test Documentation and Maintenance Framework
tasks.description: Develop complete test documentation, best practices guides, troubleshooting documentation, and continuous improvement processes
tasks.details: Create comprehensive documentation including test writing guidelines, test template documentation with examples, best practices guide for provider testing, troubleshooting guide for common issues, CI/CD usage documentation, and test coverage reporting guide. Implement continuous improvement framework with test data management, fixture organization, cleanup automation, shared test data repository, and data versioning for compatibility tests. Include test debt tracking, regular review cycles, and performance trend analysis.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate documentation covers all testing scenarios, verify troubleshooting guides resolve common issues, test data management system works correctly, ensure fixture organization supports maintainability, and confirm continuous improvement processes identify and address technical debt
